report.clinical_summary: The patient has a diagnosed blood disorder affecting daily functioning — unable to get out of bed on some days, work and family time impacted. Symptoms include fatigue, occasional night sweats, and persistent lymph nodes in the neck. They report headaches as a side effect of the prescribed medication, which they are following but question whether it is worth it. They feel uncertain about the illness's long-term course, worry about it keeping them up at night, and describe it as a 'waiting game'.
